name: @skills-hub/pi-adapter
description: Pi agent extensions for the skills-hub harness-agnostic system

extensions.name: memory
extensions.description: Injects Engram memory context at session start and saves session summaries on close

extensions.name: skill-resolver
extensions.description: Reads skill registry and injects compact rules into system prompt

extensions.name: session-guard
extensions.description: Intercepts destructive shell commands and asks for user confirmation
